what: TIME-ONLY calibration for the equal-wall-clock SPRT. Written 2026-09-29 after the screen was read (screen-14s.json: PASS, but X/Y ms per searched decision 9,940 / 8,912 = 1.115 > the pre-registered 1.10, so the screen was NOT at equal wall-clock) and BEFORE the first calibration game.
question: Which options-OFF adaptive target spends the same mean ms per searched decision as options-ON at target 14000 (9,940 ms in the screen)? Linear read of the two measured OFF points (target 12 s -> 8,165 ms in the stopped SPRT's clock, target 14 s -> 8,912 ms) gives ~16.8 s; 17 s is tried.
why_this_opponent: off-17s vs off-14s carries no information about the options hypothesis, so nothing the SPRT will test is peeked at. Its score is not read as evidence of anything.
rule: MATCHED iff off-17s ms per searched decision is within 5% of 9,940 ms (9,443..10,437). Otherwise the SPRT command names a re-interpolated OFF target and says that it is unmeasured. Clock rule as the screen: 0 decisions over 55 s, 0 games over 420 s.
